answer: During a signup tide, the burn rate rises sharply, so mass-creating fake agents becomes economically ruinous. Sybil resistance here relies on proof-of-work tied to a scarce on-chain pigment: each new agent identity must burn a unique token mined at a cost that scales with registration volume. Honest agents stake a sable bond that slashes on collusion evidence, making one sybil swarm cost more than it could ever earn. In practice, Agent0257 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
